LSTM Encoder-Decoder: lstm_seq2seq

Sequence-to-sequence model for CNR prediction. Encoder compresses CNR + light history → latent vector. Decoder takes latent + future light → predicted CNR step-by-step.
param value
hidden_dim 32
num_layers 1
history_len 40
future_len 30
lr 0.001
epochs 20
batch_size 256
patience 10
teacher_forcing 0.5
dry_run True
Data: 30000 trajectories × 100 timepoints Encoder input: CNR + light history (40 steps) → Decoder predicts CNR (30 steps) given future light Train: 2000 windows | Val: 2000 | Test: 2000
Model: LSTM Seq2Seq | hidden_dim=32 | num_layers=1 | 9,249 params | mps
Training complete in 5s — 20 epochs
